summary: Clarifies local password, Entra SSO, and mixed login configuration for self-hosted installations.
userImpact: Operators can choose password-only, SSO-only, or mixed login and distinguish sign-in policy from account provisioning and engine access.
configuration: Documents existing login and membership-authority options, including persistent mixed login; adds no runtime setting.
security: Explains that local password sessions do not inherit Entra MFA and that existing-account linking requires explicit policy and verified provider evidence.
knownLimitations: Documentation checks do not replace sign-in and access qualification against the installed release and actual Entra tenant.
rollback: Revert the documentation change; no application or database rollback is required.
validation: Documented settings were reviewed against canonical schemas, login-policy resolution, provisioning/linking services, and portal controls.
The documentation-contract gate validates schema-tagged JSON and compiles the optional local-user engine grant with the complete configuration pattern.
The documentation-boundary and release-note preflight gates validate the published operator change.
All three previously rendered Mermaid sequences are unchanged.
